title: Bauhaus Tetris
description: Guideline Tetris with a museum-quality Bauhaus editorial aesthetic.
detailedDescription: A meticulous recreation of classic guideline Tetris wrapped in the iconic visual language of the Bauhaus school. Every element â€” from the bold primary color palette and geometric Utopian typeface to the grid-based layout and sans-serif UI â€” pays homage to the design movement that shaped modernism. Features include next-piece preview, hold piece, ghost piece, 7-bag randomizer, and wall kicks. The score system follows guideline rules with soft and hard drops, T-spin detection, and combo tracking.
controls: Arrow Left/Right to move. Arrow Up to rotate. Arrow Down to soft drop. Spacebar to hard drop. C to hold piece. Clear lines to score.
